item.title: Capita chief executive steps down after pension payment failures
item.body: Capita chief executive Adolfo Hernandez has agreed with the board to step down with immediate effect. He admitted the firm has "not delivered" for retired civil servants waiting for pension payments. Its shares have plunged 67%.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 📉 Capita chief executive steps down after pension payment failures

Capita chief executive Adolfo Hernandez has agreed with the board to step down with immediate effect. He admitted the firm has "not delivered" for retired civil servants waiting for pension payments. Its shares have plunged 67%.

Source: Guardian | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 23 November, 10:20
